question: The cost price of 120 g of rice is the same as the selling price of 150 g of it. The percentage loss is:
solution:

Cost price of 120 g = Selling price of 150 g 

**FORMULA USED:**

Loss = C.P. - S.P. 

Loss% = ( Loss / C.P.) × 100 

Where, C.P. = Cost price, S.P. = Selling Price
